curriculum: University of Dhaka B.S. Honours Statistics 2023–24

sources.institution: University of Dhaka, Department of Statistics
sources.role: Syllabus foundation for B.S. Honours in Statistics (Courses Stat H-303 Regression Analysis & Stat H-312 Lab)

sources.institution: Montgomery, D.C., Peck, E.A., & Vining, G.G. (2021). Introduction to Linear Regression Analysis (6th ed.)
sources.role: Comprehensive reference for OLS estimation, matrix regression, diagnostics, multicollinearity, and generalized linear models

sources.institution: Seber, G.A.F., & Lee, A.J. (2003). Linear Regression Analysis (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Rigorous mathematical treatment of orthogonal projections, Gauss-Markov theorem, quadratic forms, and linear hypothesis testing

sources.institution: Kutner, M.H., Nachtsheim, C.J., Neter, J., & Li, W. (2005). Applied Linear Statistical Models (5th ed.)
sources.role: Standard methodological text for ANOVA decompositions, simultaneous inference, WLS, autocorrelation, and polynomial/spline models

sources.institution: Belsley, D.A., Kuh, E., & Welsch, R.E. (1980). Regression Diagnostics: Identifying Influential Data and Sources of Collinearity
sources.role: Foundational work on leverage, studentized residuals, DFFITS, DFBETAS, Cook's distance, and condition indices
